info.title: Lumen Gateway Laravel Sandbox
info.description: Laravel/MySQL multi-merchant simulator. QR scan records a test payment once; VAs are synthetic. No real funds. API protocol and HMAC remain compatible with Lumen Studio. Portal session tokens are distinct from API credentials.

servers.description: Local development; replace with your HTTPS deployment
